# GPCloud Provider

Use the `gpcloud` provider to interact with resources provided by the GPCloud API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "gpcloud" {
  api_url = "https://api.gpcloud.example.com"
}

resource "gpcloud_item" "example" {
  name = "hello"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) Base URL of the GPCloud API endpoint. Defaults to the production endpoint if not set.
